newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS 580,000 LATS BY MAY 8.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS 580,000 LATS BY MAY 8.

text.p: Latvia's state budget surplus for 1997 amounted to 580,000 lats by May 8, the state exchequer said on Monday.
Revenues reached 187.47 million lats and expenditure was 186.89 million lats, the state exchequer said in a statement.
It also said that the state's internal debt totalled 432.58 million lats.
This was financed by the issue of state Treasury bills worth 142.02 million lats and credits from commercial banks worth 9.94 million lats as well as 27.23 million lats in IMF credits.
